name: Cabal
description: The Cabal is a black-aligned order of Dominaria, founded on Otaria by Virot Maglan, that ran pit fights and worshipped Kuberr before becoming a death cult under the demon Belzenlok.

description_citations.text: "Cabal", section "Foundation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: The Cabal is a black-aligned order of Dominaria, founded on Otaria by Virot Maglan, that ran pit fights and worshipped Kuberr before becoming a death cult under the demon Belzenlok.

citations.text: "Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal", section "Foundation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Virot Maglan founded the Cabal after the collapse of Suderbod, focused on commerce, and it grew in wealth and influence through its pit fights, especially after the Phyrexian Invasion.

citations.text: "Cabal", section "Foundation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal", section "Pit fights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Battle for the Mirari Chainer usurped the Cabal, and he lost control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl, after which Cabal City was abandoned.

citations.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Cabalists fought and allied with various forces, including Kamahl and the Order, and Braids killed the Patriarch with a nightmare beast while Phage and Braids took control of the Cabal.

citations.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Order", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After Karona's War the Cabal was left with no leader and no god and was presumed defunct around 4500 AR.

citations.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the Mending a Cabal group's spell accidentally freed the demonlord Belzenlok, who restored the Cabal's power and moved its capital to the Stronghold in Urborg.

citations.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Under Belzenlok the Cabal spread across Dominaria as a death cult and routed the Church of Serra, until the Weatherlight crew under Jhoira defeated the Stronghold and killed Belzenlok.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.
"Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Weatherlight Crew". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After Belzenlok's death Lagomos maintained the Cabal until members summoned Braids to lead them, and later Cabal agents infiltrated New Argive.

citations.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: The Cabal's last Dominarian story shows it crushed at the Stronghold and Belzenlok dead, with later material describing a resurgent group fought by the Benalish and an Echoverse Cabal at war with Benalia.

citations.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Around 4560 AR the Blackblade comes into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrites its origins.
timeline.quote: would come into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orggs are known to exist on Otaria around 4050 AR, possibly created by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: It is possible that they were created by the Cabal to fight in their pits.

citation.text: "Orgg", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The god Kuberr grants Virot Maglan's dreams, starting the Cabal.
timeline.quote: His dreams are granted by the god Kuberr

citation.text: "The Secrets of Magic", section "Family Man , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Balthor and Kamahl are ambushed in Krosa by Cabalists and Order Legionnaires under Laquatus.
timeline.quote: they were ambushed by Cabalists and Order Legionnaires under the influence of Ambassador Laquatus

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Braids fights in a rigged pit fight with Skellum and is knocked unconscious but survives.
timeline.quote: she escaped the fight with her life intact

citation.text: "Braids", section "In league with the Patriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan founds the Cabal in the wake of the collapse of Suderbod, focused on commerce.
timeline.quote: The Cabal was founded by Virot Maglan in 4050 AR

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Foundation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian Invasion the Cabal's pit fights grow in popularity, greatly expanding its wealth and influence.
timeline.quote: resulting in a major expansion in the wealth and influence of the Cabal

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Pit fights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan pacts with Kuberr and founds the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Virot Maglan sealed a pact with the god Kuberr and gained the power to kill using touch

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl; the city is condemned and abandoned.
timeline.quote: the ruined city was completely abandoned by the Cabal

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal decays and the ruins become a refugee camp.
timeline.quote: The ruins of Cabal City turned into a refugee camp for cabalists

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kirtar competes in the Cabal's largest pit-fight tournament in Cabal City, hoping to win an artifact for the Order to destroy.
timeline.quote: Hoping to claim a powerful artifact for the Order to destroy

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Pit fighter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer finds the Mirari in an old mansion and gives it to the First as a tournament prize.
timeline.quote: The Mirari was found by Chainer in an old mansion

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal controls most of the land and wealth, running pit fights for the masses.
timeline.quote: it operates pit fights for entertainment of the masses and, for the one lucky pit warrior who survives, fame and fortune

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace.
timeline.quote: strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Turg's eggs yield a tadpole, Uurg, who escapes the Cabal and roams Otaria.
timeline.quote: one of the tadpoles escaped their control

citation.text: "Turg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teroh vows to be the holy wind that avenges the Cabal's victims.
timeline.quote: I am the holy wind that shall avenge the Cabal's victims.

citation.text: Major Teroh (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault and spreads darkness over Otaria.
timeline.quote: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

citation.text: Cabal Coffers (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Cabalists raise Balthor as a zombie, Balthor the Defiled, who hunts Laquatus.
timeline.quote: The Cabalists raised him as a zombie

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Balthor the Defiled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Commander Eesha declares the aven will not be victims of treachery, the Cabal or their own ambitions again.
timeline.quote: We have been victims of treachery, of the Cabal, and of our own ambitions. No more.

citation.text: Border Patrol (Judgment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Braids pockets the Mirari, immune to its lure, and returns it to the First.
timeline.quote: she merely pocketed it and made her way back to Cabal City

citation.text: "Braids", section "To the Mer Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Braids helps Phage and Kuberr survive an assassination attempt and kills the Cabal Patriarch with a nightmare beast.
timeline.quote: she killed the Cabal Patriarch instead with one of her nightmare beasts

citation.text: "Braids", section "Succumbing to Dementia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The reincarnated Kuberr takes over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.
timeline.quote: The reincarnated Kuberr took over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: the Cabal was left with no leader and no god

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Laquatus, trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Laquatus and his jack Burke go personally to the mainland to retrieve the Mirari

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Order contingent led by Eesha and a Cabal battalion led by Braids head to the mountains while Laquatus plays them against each other.
timeline.quote: Laquatus tries to play them against each other while pretending to be a friend of both.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cabal troops attack the village; the barbarians unite and win, and Kamahl resolves to bring the surviving Jeska to Seton, with Balthor carrying the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: Kamahl resolves to bring her to his friend Seton , deep in the Krosan forest, to cure her.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An unknown assailant attacks the camps in the forest and the Order leader is killed, blamed on the Cabal, which leaves.
timeline.quote: An unknown assailant begins to attack the camps, and the Order leader is killed, but the blame is given to the Cabal.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken and abandoned in the desert over gambling debts, Ixidor shapes Akroma from his dream at the cost of his right arm, charging her to avenge Nivea.
timeline.quote: Ixidor gave her but one objective: to avenge Nivea, no matter the cost.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Angel of Wrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl declares war on Ixidor and leads the Cabal and Krosan alliance against Topos in the Nightmare War, defeating his Mirari-possessed persona.
timeline.quote: Kamahl led the joint forces into battle

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cabal healing magic transforms Jeska into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's sister Jeska is transformed by foul Cabal healing magic, into Phage

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal strip Ixidor and abandon him in the desert after discovering his forged coins.
timeline.quote: The Cabal officers knock him out and leave him naked in the desert, where he swears revenge upon Phage.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and the Cabal, in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma.
timeline.quote: Kamahl and the Cabal , in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma .

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and Braids recovers her sanity and summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch; Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal in place of Kuberr.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault, its darkness radiating across Otaria.
timeline.quote: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun

citation.text: Cabal Coffers (Planechase, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Cabal captures Josu and makes him a lich dedicated to Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: the Cabal made a lich dedicated to Belzenlok

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal reconstructs and reanimates the lich Josu.
timeline.quote: the Cabal soon found a way to both reconstruct and reanimate the lich that was Josu

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Needle presents a black soul-drinking sword to Sadage as a gift for the Scion of Darkness.
timeline.quote: I bring you a gift for the Scion of Darkness.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: At the inn, Liliana tends Gideon's wound while the innkeeper says the Cabal has taken over the region.
timeline.quote: It's the Cabal,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The innkeeper says the Church of Serra was routed by the Cabal in a battle days earlier.
timeline.quote: The Church of Serra came to help and there was a great battle only a few days ago, but the Cabal routed us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Cabal undead knights attack the town at nightfall.
timeline.quote: She had barely started on the path through the ruins when she sensed the surge of undead malice.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana destroys a dozen knights with necromantic bolts.
timeline.quote: As the etchings on her skin flared violet, bolts shot out from her hands to strike a dozen black-armored knights.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A panicked man reports a Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile.
timeline.quote: A Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira watches through her owl as a swordswoman fights Cabal agents on a warehouse roof.
timeline.quote: one woman with a sword fought half a dozen men wearing the concealing robes of desert nomads.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna explains the Cabal agents wanted route maps to attack merchants.
timeline.quote: Cabal agents, trying to get the merchants' route maps

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana and the angels find the town and the Great Machine destroyed by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They circled around the plateau and Tiana saw what was left of the Great Machine.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra attributes the destruction to the Cabal.
timeline.quote: This is the work of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad says he fights the Cabal and sometimes feeds in battle.
timeline.quote: I fight the Cabal whenever I can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana concludes a Cabal cleric used dementia magic.
timeline.quote: It's dementia magic all around, I'm afraid,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok's Cabal is hailed with a litany of titles.
timeline.quote: "All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . ."

citation.text: Cabal Evangel (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Cabal legions pushed into Shiv.
timeline.quote: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

citation.text: Radiating Lightning (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Cabal's expansion corrupts the great expanses of the empire.
timeline.quote: However, the expansion of The Cabal corrupted the great expanses of the empire.

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Influence of the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, a Cabal group's spell summons the demonlord Belzenlok, who maims the cabalists and demands they serve him instead of Kuberr.
timeline.quote: the demonlord Belzenlok burst forth from the rift from the Abyss it created

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok restores the Cabal's power, shifting its capital to the Stronghold of Urborg and expanding across Dominaria as a death cult.
timeline.quote: the Cabal shifted their capital to the Stronghold of Urborg

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Belzenlok's death Lagomos maintains the Cabal until members summon Braids to lead them.
timeline.quote: until its members summoned their former member Braids to lead them

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold and kills Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: managed to defeat the Cabal's Stronghold and kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira finds and rebuilds the Weatherlight and assembles a new crew against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: assembled a new crew to fight against the rising Cabal

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Restoring the Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana learns the Cabal's master is her brother, transformed into a lich.
timeline.quote: she learned that their master was no other than her brother Josu, who had been transformed into a Lich by Belzenlok's cultists

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha is captured by the Cabal and forced to fight in the Stronghold's pit; Gideon Jura's arrival lets her escape, and she kills Whisper.
timeline.quote: During the escape, she ended up killing Whisper .

citation.text: "Radha", section "Fighting the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha helps Gideon and Chandra find the Blackblade and organizes the spirits of Urborg against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: and organized the spirits of Urborg in their attack on the Cabal .

citation.text: "Radha", section "Fighting the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending the Cabal under Belzenlok moves its capital to Urborg, and the panther warriors are nearly wiped out.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok styled himself as "King of Urborg."

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Under the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries later Belzenlok takes control of The Cabal, lives in Volrath's ruined stronghold and rewrites history to claim he had been evincar.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok rewrote Dominaria's history, claiming that he had been Evincar instead of Volrath.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot climbs on deck, sees open water, and meets Karn, who tells it the ship is heading to Urborg to destroy Belzenlok in the Cabal's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We are on our way to Urborg, to destroy the demon Belzenlok in the Stronghold of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The time spell ends and the Stronghold fills with noise as Cabal cultists run to the defenses.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the silence around them filled like water poured into a bowl.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Whisper begins to kill the pit prisoners with black mist, and Chandra attacks her and her guards with fire.
timeline.quote: Whisper was going to kill the rest of the prisoners in the pit.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chainer banishes the First to Aphetto and takes control of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Chainer banished him to the southern city of Aphetto and assumed control of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Argive is devastated during the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovers, then faces infiltration by Cabal agents.
timeline.quote: New Argive was devastated during the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovered.

citation.text: "New Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, envy of House Capashen causes a civil war that drives them into the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Later, the various houses of Benalia began envying House Capashen, the mightiest at the time, leading to a civil war that forced the Capashens into hiding, eventually joining the Cabal .

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A group of mages forms the Raven Guild to steal illicit business from the Cabal.
timeline.quote: began coordinating their efforts to steal illicit business within the city from the Cabal

citation.text: "Aphetto", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal tried to summon Kuberr but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss.
timeline.quote: but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok began rewriting history with himself as lead and subjugated much of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: began the process of rewriting history with himself as the lead

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer usurps rulership of the Cabal and exiles the Patriarch to Aphetto; the Pit is overrun by dementia creatures.
timeline.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

citation.text: "Cabal Pit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the rise of the Cabal under Belzenlok, the forest, town and manor succumb to corruption and decay.
timeline.quote: the entire region — forest, town, and manor — succumbed to corruption and decay

citation.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The tavern owner is spared if he gives up his Ilyssa name and obeys Virot, becoming the Cabal's first unofficial member.
timeline.quote: This unnamed tavern owner was thus the very first unofficial member of the Cabal

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4305 AR, Cabal City is overrun by dementia creatures during the Battle for the Mirari as Chainer usurps the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl and the Order; the ruined city is abandoned by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: the ruined city was completely abandoned by the Cabal

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal grows in strength under the Demonlord Belzenlok, posing new threats to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: as the cult of the Cabal grows in strength, now under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok, Dominaria faces new threats

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Cabal City's destruction, the Cabal Patriarch has a new coliseum built near Aphetto under Phage's oversight.
timeline.quote: the Cabal Patriarch organized the construction of a new, even larger coliseum near Aphetto .

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor and Nivea make a living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights in Aphetto.
timeline.quote: he partnered with his love Nivea to make their living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Pit fighting in Aphetto". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor creates an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal in revenge.
timeline.quote: He also created an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal attacks Ixidor's fortress and he is consumed by a deathwurm representing Nivea's death.
